userText: My job is busy but I like it. Every day I deal carefully with many emails and questions from customers. My colleagues are friendly and we help each other. After work I usually cook dinner and read a book before sleep.
aiRevision: I enjoy my job even though it's busy. Every day I carefully handle many customer emails and questions. My colleagues are friendly, and we help each other. After work, I usually cook dinner and read a book before bed.
errorSentences: 未使用目标词 'free expression'；整段为日常描述，未体现‘自由表达’主题（如想法、感受、创意、观点等的开放表达）；'deal carefully with' 虽正确但略正式，A1 学习者更宜用 'answer' 或 'handle' 等基础动词；'before sleep' 不如 'before bed' 自然常用。
suggestions: 本次任务要求围绕'free expression'（自由表达）展开，例如：'In my art class, I can draw anything I like — it's free expression!' 或 'We share our ideas freely in English club — that's free expression.' 请尝试用简单句表达你如何自由表达自己（如画画、说话、写作、唱歌等），用词控制在A1范围（like, can, happy, draw, say, write, music），这样更贴合任务和水平。
